name: DualMA Crossover

changelog.description: EMA(10/20) crossover with volume confirmation. Thesis: dual MA crossover captures trend shifts early; volume confirms breakout. All non-EMA indicators zeroed to avoid dilution. Modeled on 151-strategies S5 (MA-based trend).

backtest_90d.verdict: DISABLED — unprofitable in choppy Jan-Apr 2026. Pure EMA crossover generates too many whipsaw entries without additional filters.
